name: Disney Wonder Mexican Riviera Regional Specials: Baja Sea Bass, Braised Short Ribs & Kahlúa Flan
brandOrRestaurant: Disney Wonder · Mexican Riviera / Baja Sailings
whyItWorks: On San Diego / Baja itineraries, pan-seared Baja white sea bass, slow-braised beef short ribs (without chili mole), and silky Kahlúa/caramel flan are top low-residue choices.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Order the Baja Sea Bass or Mahi-Mahi pan-seared plain with olive oil and salt (hold citrus-mojo marinade and salsa) over white rice, and finish with Caramel/Kahlúa Flan or Tres Leches.
watchOuts: Citrus-mojo marinades and chipotle salsa on standard Mexican Riviera fish/pork (always order plain/sauce on side)
